result.problems: 1) The Write tool refused FINDINGS.md by filename heuristic ("subagents should not write report .md files"); since the study brief names FINDINGS.md as a required deliverable read by the refuter and REPORT step, it was written via a shell heredoc with identical content. 2) One post-hoc ledger row per table (h1/not_block_asof, the as-of translation fz_gate != BLOCK of the post-column not_block) was added after the audit's numbers were seen; it is flagged post_hoc in config and counted in the family (family PBO/SPA reported both with 9 and 10 candidates). 3) block_key / not_block / skip_only variants use the post-SETUP outcome gate (11 IS rows differ from the as-of gate on 1m, 96 WATCH->REENTER rows on 5m), stated as diagnostic. 4) The FZ-book rows keep the label's exit bar in Table.with_label (splitter unused in this study). 5) Control percentile (session-matched) and pooled diff disagree in sign for some near-complete keeps (e.g. skip_only:BLOCK:open_pierce diff -477 / pct 100); explained in FINDINGS section 1. 6) Group tables are descriptive decompositions of the frozen ledger row computed with pandas, not ledger rows; no rule was chosen on them. 7) git status shows fz_v3/out/build/build.py modified and fz_v3/out/features_ext/ untracked; neither was touched by this study.
